description_for_human: Drive a real Chrome browser from your agent, in the cloud or on your own machine, with logged-in sessions that persist.
description_for_model: Use this to drive a real Chrome browser. A browser can run in the cloud (provisioned on demand), on a third-party provider (Browserbase, Steel, Anchor, Browser Use), or on the user's own machine with their real cookies, sessions and extensions; the command surface is the same either way. You can navigate, analyze DOM content as markdown, TOON or JSONL, click, type, screenshot, manage tabs and scroll. Every interactive element is numbered so you can refer to it by ID; analyze the page after any action to get fresh IDs. A persona ties a fingerprint, cookie jar and proxy into one identity, so a logged-in session stays valid across runs and providers. A human can watch a run live and take over without stopping it. Setup for an agent that runs code: https://oyabrowser.com/llms.txt, section 'Agent quickstart' (SDK @oya-ai/browser: Oya.signup, then desktop.connect).
